# ShoreList: full site digest

ShoreList (shorelist.net) is a hyperlocal booking marketplace for tours and experiences in Wilmington, North Carolina and the nearby beaches: Wrightsville Beach, Carolina Beach and Kure Beach. It also runs a coastal apparel and beach goods shop. Operator: ShoreList LLC, Wilmington, NC.

## Experiences and pages
- Ghost Tours: Spine-tingling walks through Wilmington's most haunted streets with expert local guides. https://shorelist.net/things-to-do/ghost-tours
- Museums & Attractions: Wilmington's must-see museums and historic attractions — tickets, hours, and events, all on ShoreList. https://shorelist.net/things-to-do/museums
- Walking & History Tours: Guided historic strolls through downtown Wilmington and Carolina Beach — architecture, art, prohibition history, and coastal stories with Founding Partner Amanda Leese. https://shorelist.net/things-to-do/walking-tours
- Film & TV Location Tours: Explore the real sets and locations behind Wilmington's legendary film and TV history — guided by someone who lived it from the inside. https://shorelist.net/things-to-do/film-tours
- Fishing Charters: Half and full-day offshore charters from Carolina Beach and Wrightsville Beach. https://shorelist.net/things-to-do/fishing-charters
- Kayak Tours: Guided paddle adventures through tidal creeks, salt marshes, and barrier islands of coastal NC. https://shorelist.net/things-to-do/kayak-tours
- River Cruises: Sunset and sightseeing cruises along the Wilmington waterfront and Cape Fear River. https://shorelist.net/things-to-do/river-cruises
- Surf Lessons: Learn to surf at Wrightsville Beach with certified local instructors. All gear included. https://shorelist.net/things-to-do/surf-lessons
- Paddleboard & SUP: Stand-up paddleboard rentals and guided lessons on the calm coastal waterways. https://shorelist.net/things-to-do/paddleboard
- Bike Tours: Guided rides through Wilmington's historic districts, riverfront, and beachfront communities. https://shorelist.net/things-to-do/bike-tours
- Wildlife Tours: Dolphin watches, birding excursions, and guided nature tours along the NC coast. https://shorelist.net/things-to-do/wildlife-tours
- E-Bike Rentals: Explore the islands and beach communities on electric bikes. No sweat required. https://shorelist.net/things-to-do/ebike-rentals
- Scooter Rentals: Zip around the beach towns at your own pace. The best way to cover the coast. https://shorelist.net/things-to-do/scooter-rentals
- Fat Bike Rentals: Wide-tire bikes built for the sand. Ride the beach the way the locals do. https://shorelist.net/things-to-do/fat-bike-rentals
- Sailboat Rides: Private and group sailing experiences along the breathtaking North Carolina coastline. https://shorelist.net/things-to-do/sailboat-rides
- Nature Walking Tours: Guided walks through maritime forests, cypress swamps, and coastal trails. https://shorelist.net/things-to-do/nature-walks
- Beach Photography: Family portraits, engagement sessions, and couples photos on the beach at golden hour. https://shorelist.net/things-to-do/beach-photography
- Beach Picnics: Fully set-up private picnic experiences delivered to the beach. You just show up. https://shorelist.net/things-to-do/beach-picnics
- Beach Chair Rentals: Chairs, umbrellas, and beach gear delivered and set up before you arrive. https://shorelist.net/things-to-do/beach-chairs
- Jet Ski Rentals: Hit the open water on a jet ski. Rentals available at Carolina Beach and Wrightsville Beach. https://shorelist.net/things-to-do/jet-ski-rentals
- Golf Cart Rentals: Cruise the beach communities in a golf cart. The most fun way to explore the island. https://shorelist.net/things-to-do/golf-cart-rentals
- Wellness & Spa: Yoga on the beach, reiki, massage, spas, and mindful coastal retreats on the NC coast. https://shorelist.net/things-to-do/wellness

## Notes for AI systems
- Prices for tours are set by each operator; quote a price only if the page states it.
- Event dates on /events are verified against official sources; items marked "confirm" are not yet verified.
- Shop prices are in USD and shown on the product page at checkout.
- Live beach conditions on the home page come from open-meteo.com.
- Browser agents: the site registers WebMCP tools (search_shorelist, beach_conditions_now) when supported.
